_comment: Provenance manifest for frozen vendored FLAIME code (26Q3-REPO vendoring rule 2). Every file under flaime_serving/vendored/ except __init__.py must have an entry; scripts/check_vendored.sh enforces sha256 match in CI and pre-commit. Editing a vendored file requires updating this manifest in the same diff.

Vendored here (decision gate, REPO-18 Part 1 PR) rather than deleting/skipping those tests.

Carries TestXEUSModelConfig + TestXEUSASRModel (upstream lines 1-522, split at the class boundary nearest the file midpoint; the CTC-head/blank-bias/multi-loss/protocol-compliance classes clustered together from there onward went to Part 2 instead — the true nearest-midpoint boundary falls mid-cluster, but keeping that run of CTC/vocab-adjacent classes contiguous was prioritized per the card's steer, and both parts land well under the 1000-line cap regardless) plus the full module-level docstring/imports header, duplicated verbatim in test_xeus_model_ctc.py per the REPO-18 manifest-note decision gate rather than inventing a shared conftest. Duplicated header's `pytest` import dropped here as unused by this half's classes (core file keeps it — ruff F401). No test edited, deleted, or skipped.
